user.title: FX Luminaire Luxor
user.description: Enter the IP address of your Luxor controller. Give it a DHCP reservation first so the address doesn't change.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Luxor controller, e.g. 192.168.60.73

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Luxor controller. Check the IP and that Home Assistant can reach it on TCP port 80.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for changes made outside Home Assistant (facepack schedule, Luxor app). Changes made from Home Assistant show immediately.
